branches.title: Branches
branches.lead: Your clinic's branches: address, phone and who works where. The main branch is the clinic itself.
branches.off_confirm: This branch will no longer appear in booking or on the website. Its doctors and upcoming appointments must be moved first.
branches.delete_confirm: Delete this branch for good? Only a branch that was never used can be deleted.
branches.locked_title: More than one branch is not in your package
branches.locked_text: Your package includes the main branch only. Choose a package with more branches to add branches.
branches.full_title: You have reached your package's branches ({n})
branches.full_text: To add another branch, choose more branches on the subscription page.
branches.usage: Active branches: {used} of {n} (including the main branch).
branches.empty_text: No other branches yet. Add a branch to set its doctors and appointments.
branches.how: After adding a branch, choose each doctor's branch on their profile. Each appointment takes its doctor's branch; in online booking the patient picks the branch first.
branches.work_branch_help: The doctor appears under this branch in online booking, and their appointments take place there.
branches.others_sub: Added a separate clinic with “Add a clinic” but meant a branch? Make it a branch here: the branch takes its name, address and phone, and its doctors are copied into it.
branches.merge_keeps: It has patients or appointments, so it stays a separate clinic with its records — records are never moved between clinics.
branches.merge_confirm: Make “{name}” a branch of this clinic?
branches.merge_confirm_empty: Make “{name}” a branch of this clinic? With the delete option ticked, the separate clinic is deleted for good.
branches.merged: Branch added; {n} doctor(s) copied into it.
branches.merged_removed: Branch added; {n} doctor(s) copied into it, and the separate clinic was deleted.
branches.member_branch_help: A member tied to a branch works there only: its appointments, cash desk and reports. "All branches" can switch.
branches.short_name_help: Shown in the top bar instead of the long name, e.g. Abdali
branches.main_short: Short name of the main branch
branches.patient_help: The patient shows in the ticked branches only. To move: tick the new one and untick the old. Both: tick both.
branches.also_in_help: The doctor shows in these branches' calendars too; a visit is booked in the branch you work in. Pay stays with the main branch.
